## 🛠️ Fixed: the ribbon hidden under the taskbar

On some touch boards (especially 4K boards with Windows scaling at 200–300 %), ClassBoard opened with its bottom, and so the ribbon, behind the Windows taskbar. Before, you had to go full screen and back on every start.

ClassBoard now **fits the screen by itself on every start**, whatever the resolution or scaling:

- Closed in **full screen**? It opens in full screen.
- Otherwise it opens **maximized above the taskbar**, so the ribbon is always visible.
- If you made the window smaller, it reopens at that size, but only if it still fits on the screen.

You don't need to change anything: just install this version.

## ✨ New: animated installer

- While ClassBoard installs, the installer plays a short **board animation**: a pen draws a triangle, a compass a circle and a graph is plotted. It is extra sharp on 4K boards.
- The installer now has a **minimize** button, so it can finish in the background.

## Also included

Everything from earlier versions: **Ribbon size** (More → Settings), the **Calculator** (More → Calculator), the PDF user guide in the Start menu, 10-point multi-touch, and erasing part of a shape.

## Install

1. Download **ClassBoard-Setup-0.3.2-x64.exe** below and run it.
2. If Windows shows *"Windows protected your PC"*, click **More info → Run anyway**. The installer is not digitally signed.
3. Already have ClassBoard? Run the new installer over it: your lessons and settings are kept.

Works on Windows 10 / 11, fully offline.
